017package org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.CollectionUtils.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
022
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
026
027/**
028 * Fluent builder for a restricted elicitation JSON Schema (MCP {@code 2026-07-28} SEP-2322), producing the
029 * {@link JsonMap} consumed by {@link ElicitRequest#setRequestedSchema(java.util.Map)}.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * The elicitation restricted schema permits only primitive-typed, non-nested top-level properties. There is
033 * deliberately no {@code objectField}/{@code arrayField} method, so a nested/object/array-typed field is a
034 * compile-time impossibility, never a runtime-rejected one. {@link #build()} additionally rejects a handful of
035 * structurally-invalid per-field modifier combinations (for example {@link #format(String)} on a non-string
036 * field) with an {@link IllegalStateException}, so a handler author gets an immediate, in-process failure rather
037 * than a wire-level schema-validation error discovered by the client much later.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * Each {@code xxxField(name)} call starts a new field and becomes the target of every subsequent modifier call
041 * ({@link #title(String)}, {@link #description(String)}, etc.) until the next {@code xxxField(...)} call.
042 * Re-declaring a field under a {@code name} already used by an earlier {@code xxxField(...)} call replaces that
043 * field's definition entirely, silently discarding any per-field modifiers already applied to it
044 * (last-field-wins). {@link #minLength(int)}/{@link #maxLength(int)} are additional string-only per-field
045 * modifiers, alongside {@link #format(String)}. {@link #required(String...)} is a separate, builder-level (not
046 * per-field) call that marks one or more field names required, emitting a top-level {@code "required":[...]}
047 * array; unlike the per-field modifiers, it is not tied to the most-recently-started field, is order-independent
048 * with respect to {@code xxxField(...)} (a name may be marked required before or after the field it names is
049 * (re)declared, and a redeclaration of that field does not discard the marking), and may be called any time,
050 * with an unknown name validated only at {@link #build()} time.
051 *
052 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
053 * <p class='bjava'>
054 *    JsonMap <jv>schema</jv> = ElicitSchema.<jsm>create</jsm>()
055 *       .booleanField(<js>"confirm"</js>).title(<js>"Confirm"</js>)
056 *       .build();
057 * </p>
058 */
059@SuppressWarnings({
060   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., PROP_minLength, ARG_value)
061})
062public class ElicitSchema {
063
064   private static final String TYPE_STRING = "string";
065   private static final String TYPE_NUMBER = "number";
066   private static final String TYPE_INTEGER = "integer";
067   private static final String TYPE_BOOLEAN = "boolean";
068   private static final String TYPE_OBJECT = "object";
069
070   private static final Set<String> NUMERIC_TYPES = Set.of(TYPE_NUMBER, TYPE_INTEGER);
071
072   // Property name constants (wire JSON-schema keys)
073   private static final String PROP_minLength = "minLength";
074   private static final String PROP_maxLength = "maxLength";
075
076   // Argument name constant for assertArgNotNull
077   private static final String ARG_value = "value";
078
079   private final Map<String,JsonMap> properties = map();
080   private final Set<String> required = new LinkedHashSet<>();
081   private String currentField;
082
083   private ElicitSchema() {}
084
085   /**
086    * Creates a new, empty schema builder.
087    *
088    * @return A new builder. Never <jk>null</jk>.
089    */
090   public static ElicitSchema create() {
091      return new ElicitSchema();
092   }
093
094   /**
095    * Starts a {@code string}-typed field.
096    *
097    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
098    * @return This object (for method chaining).
099    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code name} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
100    */
101   public ElicitSchema stringField(String name) {
102      return field(name, TYPE_STRING);
103   }
104
105   /**
106    * Starts a {@code number}-typed (floating-point) field.
107    *
108    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
109    * @return This object (for method chaining).
110    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code name} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
111    */
112   public ElicitSchema numberField(String name) {
113      return field(name, TYPE_NUMBER);
114   }
115
116   /**
117    * Starts an {@code integer}-typed field.
118    *
119    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
120    * @return This object (for method chaining).
121    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code name} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
122    */
123   public ElicitSchema integerField(String name) {
124      return field(name, TYPE_INTEGER);
125   }
126
127   /**
128    * Starts a {@code boolean}-typed field.
129    *
130    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
131    * @return This object (for method chaining).
132    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code name} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
133    */
134   public ElicitSchema booleanField(String name) {
135      return field(name, TYPE_BOOLEAN);
136   }
137
138   /**
139    * Starts a closed-choice {@code string}-typed field restricted to {@code values} (wire shape:
140    * {@code type:"string", enum:[...]}). Pair with {@link #enumNames(String...)} for parallel display labels.
141    *
142    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
143    * @param values The allowed values. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or empty, and must not contain a
144    *    <jk>null</jk> element.
145    * @return This object (for method chaining).
146    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code name} is <jk>null</jk> or blank, or {@code values} is
147    *    <jk>null</jk>, empty, or contains a <jk>null</jk> element.
148    */
149   public ElicitSchema enumField(String name, String...values) {
150      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("name", name);
151      if (values == null || values.length == 0)
152         throw iaex("Field ''%s'': enumField values must not be null or empty", name);
153      for (var value : values)
154         if (value == null)
155            throw iaex("Field ''%s'': enumField values must not contain a null element", name);
156      field(name, TYPE_STRING);
157      properties.get(name).put("enum", List.of(values));
158      return this;
159   }
160
161   private ElicitSchema field(String name, String type) {
162      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("name", name);
163      var p = new JsonMap();
164      p.put("type", type);
165      // Last-field-wins: a redeclared field discards its prior per-field modifiers (see class Javadoc).
166      // required(...) marking is a separate, builder-level set and deliberately survives a redeclaration.
167      properties.put(name, p);
168      currentField = name;
169      return this;
170   }
171
172   /**
173    * Sets the display title of the most-recently-started field.
174    *
175    * @param value The title. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
176    * @return This object (for method chaining).
177    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is <jk>null</jk>.
178    */
179   public ElicitSchema title(String value) {
180      currentProperty().put("title", assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value));
181      return this;
182   }
183
184   /**
185    * Sets the description of the most-recently-started field.
186    *
187    * @param value The description. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
188    * @return This object (for method chaining).
189    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is <jk>null</jk>.
190    */
191   public ElicitSchema description(String value) {
192      currentProperty().put("description", assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value));
193      return this;
194   }
195
196   /**
197    * Sets the string-subtype format of the most-recently-started field (for example {@code email}, {@code uri},
198    * {@code date}, {@code date-time}). Applying this to a non-string field is rejected at {@link #build()} time.
199    *
200    * @param value The format token. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
201    * @return This object (for method chaining).
202    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is <jk>null</jk>.
203    */
204   public ElicitSchema format(String value) {
205      currentProperty().put("format", assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value));
206      return this;
207   }
208
209   /**
210    * Sets the minimum UTF-16 code-unit length of the most-recently-started string field. Applying this to a
211    * non-string field, to an {@link #enumField(String, String...)} (a closed-choice field, where a length
212    * constraint is meaningless), or a value that is negative or exceeds a previously-/subsequently-set
213    * {@link #maxLength(int)}, is rejected at {@link #build()} time.
214    *
215    * @param value The minimum length.
216    * @return This object (for method chaining).
217    */
218   public ElicitSchema minLength(int value) {
219      currentProperty().put(PROP_minLength, value);
220      return this;
221   }
222
223   /**
224    * Sets the maximum UTF-16 code-unit length of the most-recently-started string field. Applying this to a
225    * non-string field, to an {@link #enumField(String, String...)} (a closed-choice field, where a length
226    * constraint is meaningless), or a value that is negative or less than a previously-/subsequently-set
227    * {@link #minLength(int)}, is rejected at {@link #build()} time.
228    *
229    * @param value The maximum length.
230    * @return This object (for method chaining).
231    */
232   public ElicitSchema maxLength(int value) {
233      currentProperty().put(PROP_maxLength, value);
234      return this;
235   }
236
237   /**
238    * Sets the minimum value of the most-recently-started number/integer field. Applying this to a field of any
239    * other type is rejected at {@link #build()} time.
240    *
241    * @param value The minimum. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
242    * @return This object (for method chaining).
243    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is <jk>null</jk>.
244    */
245   public ElicitSchema min(Number value) {
246      currentProperty().put("minimum", assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value));
247      return this;
248   }
249
250   /**
251    * Sets the maximum value of the most-recently-started number/integer field. Applying this to a field of any
252    * other type is rejected at {@link #build()} time.
253    *
254    * @param value The maximum. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
255    * @return This object (for method chaining).
256    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is <jk>null</jk>.
257    */
258   public ElicitSchema max(Number value) {
259      currentProperty().put("maximum", assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value));
260      return this;
261   }
262
263   /**
264    * Sets the default value of the most-recently-started field.
265    *
266    * <p>
267    * Named {@code defaultValue}, not {@code default} (a reserved Java keyword) &mdash; the wire schema property
268    * this writes is still literally {@code "default"}.
269    *
270    * @param value The default value. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
271    * @return This object (for method chaining).
272    */
273   public ElicitSchema defaultValue(Object value) {
274      currentProperty().put("default", value);
275      return this;
276   }
277
278   /**
279    * Sets parallel display labels for the most-recently-started {@link #enumField(String, String...)}'s values.
280    * Applying this to a field with no {@code enum} values is rejected at {@link #build()} time.
281    *
282    * @param values The display labels, parallel in order to the field's {@code enum} values. Must not be
283    *    <jk>null</jk> or empty, must not contain a <jk>null</jk> element, and (when the current field already
284    *    carries {@code enum} values) must be the same length as those values.
285    * @return This object (for method chaining).
286    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code values} is <jk>null</jk>, empty, or contains a <jk>null</jk>
287    *    element, or if its length does not match the current field's existing {@code enum} values' length.
288    */
289   public ElicitSchema enumNames(String...values) {
290      if (values == null || values.length == 0)
291         throw iaex("enumNames values must not be null or empty");
292      for (var value : values)
293         if (value == null)
294            throw iaex("enumNames values must not contain a null element");
295      var p = currentProperty();
296      var enumValues = (List<?>)p.get("enum");
297      if (enumValues != null && enumValues.size() != values.length)
298         throw iaex("enumNames length (%s) must match enum length (%s)", values.length, enumValues.size());
299      p.put("enumNames", List.of(values));
300      return this;
301   }
302
303   /**
304    * Marks one or more already-added field names required, contributing to the built schema's top-level
305    * {@code "required":[...]} array.
306    *
307    * <p>
308    * Unlike the per-field modifiers ({@link #title(String)}, etc.), this is a builder-level, not per-field,
309    * call &mdash; it is not tied to the most-recently-started field and may name any field(s) already added via
310    * an earlier {@code xxxField(...)} call, in any order. May be called more than once; each call adds to the
311    * previously-marked names (not replaced). Naming a field not (yet) added is rejected at {@link #build()}
312    * time, not here, since a later {@code xxxField(...)} call may still add it.
313    *
314    * @param names The field names to mark required. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or empty, and must not contain
315    *    a <jk>null</jk> element.
316    * @return This object (for method chaining).
317    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code names} is <jk>null</jk>, empty, or contains a <jk>null</jk>
318    *    element.
319    */
320   public ElicitSchema required(String...names) {
321      if (names == null || names.length == 0)
322         throw iaex("required field names must not be null or empty");
323      for (var name : names)
324         if (name == null)
325            throw iaex("required field names must not contain a null element");
326      Collections.addAll(required, names);
327      return this;
328   }
329
330   private JsonMap currentProperty() {
331      if (currentField == null)
332         throw isex("No field has been started yet; call stringField(...)/numberField(...)/etc. first");
333      return properties.get(currentField);
334   }
335
336   /**
337    * Validates every field's modifier combination (and the builder-level {@link #required(String...)}
338    * marking) and builds the final restricted-schema {@link JsonMap}
339    * ({@code {"type":"object","properties":{...},"required":[...]}}, the last member present only if
340    * {@link #required(String...)} was called at least once).
341    *
342    * @return The built schema, ready for {@link ElicitRequest#setRequestedSchema(java.util.Map)}.
343    * @throws IllegalStateException If no field was ever added, if any field carries a structurally-invalid
344    *    modifier combination, or if {@link #required(String...)} named a field that was never added.
345    */
346   public JsonMap build() {
347      if (properties.isEmpty())
348         throw isex("ElicitSchema requires at least one field (an empty requestedSchema is unanswerable)");
349      properties.forEach(this::validateField);
350      required.forEach(this::validateRequiredName);
351      var schema = new JsonMap();
352      schema.put("type", TYPE_OBJECT);
353      // Deep-copy each per-field map so a caller who keeps the builder and applies further modifiers after
354      // build() cannot mutate an already-returned schema.
355      var propsCopy = new JsonMap();
356      properties.forEach((name, p) -> propsCopy.put(name, new JsonMap(p)));
357      schema.put("properties", propsCopy);
358      if (! required.isEmpty())
359         schema.put("required", List.copyOf(required));
360      return schema;
361   }
362
363   /**
364    * Validates a single field's modifier combination.
365    *
366    * @param name The field name (used only for the exception message).
367    * @param p The field's per-property {@link JsonMap}.
368    * @throws IllegalStateException If the field carries a structurally-invalid modifier combination.
369    */
370   private void validateField(String name, JsonMap p) {
371      var type = (String)p.get("type");
372      validateFormat(name, p, type);
373      validateMinMax(name, p, type);
374      validateLength(name, p, type);
375      validateEnumNames(name, p);
376   }
377
378   private void validateFormat(String name, JsonMap p, String type) {
379      if (p.containsKey("format") && ! TYPE_STRING.equals(type))
380         throw isex("Field ''%s'': format is only valid on string fields", name);
381   }
382
383   private void validateMinMax(String name, JsonMap p, String type) {
384      if ((p.containsKey("minimum") || p.containsKey("maximum")) && ! NUMERIC_TYPES.contains(type))
385         throw isex("Field ''%s'': min/max are only valid on number/integer fields", name);
386   }
387
388   private void validateLength(String name, JsonMap p, String type) {
389      if ((p.containsKey(PROP_minLength) || p.containsKey(PROP_maxLength)) && ! TYPE_STRING.equals(type))
390         throw isex("Field ''%s'': minLength/maxLength are only valid on string fields", name);
391      if ((p.containsKey(PROP_minLength) || p.containsKey(PROP_maxLength)) && p.containsKey("enum"))
392         throw isex("Field ''%s'': minLength/maxLength are not valid on an enum (closed-choice) field", name);
393      if (p.containsKey(PROP_minLength) && (int)p.get(PROP_minLength) < 0)
394         throw isex("Field ''%s'': minLength must not be negative", name);
395      if (p.containsKey(PROP_maxLength) && (int)p.get(PROP_maxLength) < 0)
396         throw isex("Field ''%s'': maxLength must not be negative", name);
397      if (p.containsKey(PROP_minLength) && p.containsKey(PROP_maxLength)
398         && (int)p.get(PROP_minLength) > (int)p.get(PROP_maxLength))
399         throw isex("Field ''%s'': minLength must not exceed maxLength", name);
400   }
401
402   private void validateEnumNames(String name, JsonMap p) {
403      if (p.containsKey("enumNames") && ! p.containsKey("enum"))
404         throw isex("Field ''%s'': enumNames requires enum values (use enumField(...))", name);
405   }
406
407   private void validateRequiredName(String name) {
408      if (! properties.containsKey(name))
409         throw isex("required(...) names field ''%s'', which was never added", name);
410   }
411}
